Status
 

Click any plant to open its full profile: GA capacity, nearest IP/SV points and plants within the site's 75 km radius.

"Plants within 75 km" uses the site's own Cluster Search Radius (75 km) and its straight line distance formula. Click a row for the list of plants.

GA capacity totals by state

Each GA is counted under the one state the site's residual capacity list gives it, even where the GA spans more than one state. Total intake minus committed offtake gives the residual in the list. Click a state to list its GAs below.

"Residual (list)" is the figure in the site's Residual Capacity Indicators table and its Excel. "Residual (map panel)" is the figure the site shows as "Residual CBG Intake Capacity of the GA" when you select a GA or plant on the map; it comes from a separate part of the site and differs for some GAs (shown in bold). Plant counts are counted from the plant list using each plant's GA ID. These GA figures are gas intake capacities of the city gas network, not plant capacities.

Check any location

Enter coordinates of a proposed site. The tool finds the GA it falls in (from the site's GA boundary map), the nearest IP/SV points, and the registered plants around it.

 

Example loaded: 23.0225, 72.5714 (Ahmedabad). Replace with your own coordinates.

Layers
 

Drag to move, scroll or use + and − to zoom, click a point for details. No street map is shown; the background shapes are the site's GA boundaries.
